## Description {#details}

<p>This section contains APIs for interacting with <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/groups/llvmcsupporttypes/#ga113ce952344691b8304a43a314f8be17">LLVMValueRef</a> that correspond to <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/constant">llvm::Constant</a> instances.</p>


<p>These functions will work for any <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/groups/llvmcsupporttypes/#ga113ce952344691b8304a43a314f8be17">LLVMValueRef</a> in the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/constant">llvm::Constant</a> class hierarchy.</p>
